overview_description.description:
C Wallet Services is a a Fintech startup that provides payroll, payment and remittance services. Allowing users to receive their salary on time, providing access to e-commerce platforms including our own marketplace so users can buy and pay online even without having a bank. Daily needs like groceries and medicines can be delivered to their family’s doorstep if requested and ultimately, send money home anytime and anywhere. 

It provides financial services for the unbanked and low-income migrant workers, domestic helpers and blue collar workers. Catering mSME, Startups and home-made-business. Fast, secure, and hassle-free payments, payroll, cross border remittance mobile application.

about_short_description.short_description: CWallet is a licensed fintech company that offers digital wallet, payment, payroll, and remittance services.

product.name: CWallet E-Wallet
product.description: A mobile electronic wallet for adding funds, storing e-money, making local transfers and payments, and withdrawing funds to a Qatar bank account or through supported cash-out channels.

product.name: CWallet Remittance Services
product.description: An international money transfer service that sends funds from Qatar to supported countries through bank transfer, cash pickup, or digital wallet delivery.

product.name: CWallet QR Service
product.description: A QR payment service that lets users pay participating merchants, billing organizations, and service providers by scanning a QR code in the CWallet app.

product.name: CWallet P2P Transfers
product.description: A peer-to-peer transfer service for sending money between authorized CWallet users in Qatar.

product.name: CWallet Merchant Payments and Acquiring
product.description: Payment acceptance and settlement services that allow merchants to receive customer payments through CWallet wallet, QR, and related payment channels.

product.name: CWallet Salary and Payroll Payments
product.description: Digital salary receipt and payroll-related payment functionality that enables users to receive salary funds into their CWallet accounts and use them for transfers, payments, or remittances.
